pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with non-linear, fuzzy pixel gradients at the boundaries. The patches on the lower neck are larger in spatial area compared to the smaller, more densely packed patches visible on the mid-flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of cream-colored inter-patch pathways. Junction nodes primarily exhibit tri-radial and quad-radial intersections with thickness ranging from narrow convergence points to wider linear segments.
